name: Frostsaber Rock
summary: Frostsabers find shelter and training at Frostsaber Rock in northern Winterspring. Its stone rise overlooks the region’s snowy reaches.

sections.title: A Perch in the Tundra
sections.body: Frostsaber Rock rises over Winterspring’s frozen northern wilds. Frostsabers prowl its slopes and valleys. At the summit, Rivern Frostwind, a solitary night elf, raises and tends the cats. Alliance champions who brave the harsh conditions and prove their devotion may earn the rare privilege of learning to raise, tame, and ride one of these snowy mounts.

faq.answer: Rivern Frostwind camps at the summit and trains the frostsaber cats of the region. Alliance members seeking a frostsaber companion can look to him as a mentor.

faq.q: Can Horde players train beasts here?
faq.answer: No. Rivern Frostwind offers training and companion beasts only to trusted Alliance allies. Horde travelers find no welcome at the summit.

faq.q: What creatures are found around the rock?
faq.answer: Wild frostsaber cats roam the icy crag and nearby plateaus. Other hardy beasts native to Winterspring’s harsh climate live there as well.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, you can earn Rivern Frostwind’s trust atop the rock and begin the arduous training needed to ride the famed Winterspring frostsaber.
As a hunter, you can observe some of northern Kalimdor’s fiercest native predators on the crag and its surrounding slopes.
